The '''West Village''' is a location in the [[Rift Dimension]]. It is based on the {{zone|Village}}.

{{RiftGuide|Hacking for dummies|Gunther's Race|Complete the Mirrorverse|Ward against the fireball|Craft the Crux Ring|Cleanup the Infested House|Enigma: Hot Dog Contest|more=7|souls=7}}
== Features ==
The '''West Village''' features many attractions. The player must have secured the {{Item|Supreme Timecharm}} and have a minimum of {{stat|rt|3:00}} remaining in order to access the location.

=== Hacking ===
{{See also|Unhinged Kloon}}
After talking to {{NPCSprite|Unhinged Kloon}} in the cave near the {{zone|Black Lagoon}}, the player will receive a {{Item|Retro-Encabulating Visor}}. Wearing this will reveal wires, which when followed, each lead to a different terminal. All the terminals must be hacked, and then must be set to rainbow colors when facing [[Unhinged Kloon]]. Once completed, [[Unhinged Kloon|Kloon]] will offer the player a {{Item|Defective Monitor}} as a reward.

=== Rift Race ===
{{See also|Gunther}}
The rift race is a short parkour course around the '''West Village'''. The race can be unlocked after talking to {{NPCSprite|Gunther}}, and can be started after running over the golden pressure plate. The player must run over all {{DarkAqua|10}} checkpoints in order to complete the race. After completing the race under {{DarkAqua|60s}}, the player will receive a {{Item|Dark Pebble}} from [[Gunther]], and a {{Item|Gunthesizer Lichen}} after completing it in under {{DarkAqua|35s}}.

=== Hot Dog Contest ===
{{See also|Chef|Joey McPizza}}
In one of the buildings in the '''West Village''' is the {{NPCSprite|Chef}}'s house, where both him and [[Joey McPizza]] reside.

Talking to the [[Chef]] will greet the player with beginning the Hot Dog Contest, a {{Green|60}} second event where the Chef's furnace will rapidly spew out {{Item|Hot Dog}}s. Players must deposit a minimum of {{Item|Hot Dog|amount=50}}s on [[Joey McPizza]]'s plate to succeed in the event. Doing so will cause the [[Chef]] to reveal an [[#Enigma Souls|enigma soul]] behind the {{ID|Furnace!furnace|nolink=true}}.

=== Montezuma Cat Soul ===
{{Main|Montezuma Pet}}
Located on top of one of the buildings in the '''West Village''', the player can find the fourth [[Montezuma Pet|Montezuma Soul Piece]], which is located at {{Coords|-62|88|-81}}. Finding the soul piece will add an additional {{stat|rt|+15}} to the [[Montezuma Pet|Pet]].
